description: Conservative Republican State Representative Charlie Meier has been endorsed by 28 local mayors throughout the 109th House District. The local leaders note Meier’s leadership, experience, and dedication to the people of Southern Illinois as their top reasons to send him back to Springfield.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Citizens for Charlie Meier
title: 28 Southern Illinois Mayors Endorse Charlie Meier — Charlie Meier for State Representative
